children: SmartStop Self Storage REIT reported stable same-store occupancy with mixed web and move-in rate trends as of Aug. 31, 2026.
Physical occupancy was 92.4% vs. 92.7% a year earlier, showing near-stable utilization across same-store assets.
Greater Toronto Area 13-property portfolio occupancy rose to 92.9% from 92.2%, indicating modest improvement in that market.
Monthly web rates declined to $0.97 from $1.05, signaling softer advertised pricing year-over-year.
Monthly move-in rates fell to $0.87 from $0.94 while in-place rates ticked up to $1.70 from $1.67, reflecting mixed rate dynamics.
